name: Laravel
subtitle: PHP MVC framework
creator: Taylor Otwell
description: An expressive PHP framework with the Eloquent ORM, Blade templates, queues, events, mail and auth scaffolding, plus a large first-party ecosystem. Laravel 13 requires PHP 8.3 or newer and adds a first-party AI SDK.

languages.youWrite: PHP and Blade templates, optionally Vue or React via Inertia

concepts.explanation: Map URLs to closures or controllers.

codeSamples.label: PHP

pros: Most complete first-party ecosystem in PHP
cons: PHP's reputation in some hiring markets
Facades and magic can hide dependencies
Needs Octane or tuning at scale
Some features steer you to paid Laravel services

pricing.summary: Framework is free. Laravel sells optional hosting and tooling (Cloud, Forge, Nova).

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
